summary_for_children: Al-Jumu'ah means Friday. It tells us to leave trade and go to the prayer when called on Friday, then go out and seek Allah's bounty.
environment_concept: Market stalls shut for the Friday prayer (62:9) and reopened afterwards (62:10).
architecture_and_scenery: Market stalls, a call to prayer, and a mosque courtyard.

areas.name: Market
areas.description: Busy stalls that close for prayer.

activities.name: Seek bounty
activities.description: After the prayer, carry four baskets to the open stalls.

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: A Special Day Together
story_library.children_narration: Friday is an important day for Muslim communities. The Quran teaches believers to give attention to the remembrance of Allah when called to Friday prayer, rather than being distracted by trade and other activities.

world_idea.title: The Friday Town
world_idea.description: Explore a peaceful town as its weekly routine changes. Learn about the importance of gathering, listening, and making time for worship through interactive scheduling and exploration.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
